The script drops the 64-wide block of head 5 from each of the three 768-wide segments of `c_attn.weight` (axis 1) and `c_attn.bias` (axis 0), and from the single 768-wide row segment of `c_proj.weight` (axis 0), yielding the exact column and row ranges the spec lists in the required order.
